news.title: Oleshky: No access to basic needs, ceasefire offers limited opportunity for humanitarian assistance
news.summary: Catherine Viette is pleased to welcome Jens Schumacher, Field Coordinator in Mykolaiv and Kherson with Solidarity International. Just a few kilometers separate the Ukrainian-controlled city of Kherson from Russian-occupied Oleshky. For civilians caught between military occupation, disrupted essential services and uncertain evacuation arrangements, geographical proximity offers little guarantee of access to life-saving assistance. Schumacher examines the humanitarian implications of a temporary ceasefire around Oleshky, where approximately 2,000 civilians were reported to remain. Although the cessation of attacks has created a limited opportunity for humanitarian operations, the geographical scope of the agreement, the prospects for evacuation and the possibility of sustained humanitarian access remain uncertain.

Known for its courageous investigative journalism, the flagship newspaper said the Kremlin’s crackdown and ban on the media outlet had made it impossible to continue its work.

news.title: Governo Lula descarta escalar crise com Trump por Flávio Bolsonaro
news.summary: Nesta quinta-feira, o presidente dos EUA voltou a falar das eleições brasileiras um dia após Flávio Bolsonaro chegar aos EUA e divulgar carta se dizendo "líder" do Brasil. Vitória de Lula foi amplamente reconhecida pela Justiça e líderes políticos.

news.title: 'The International Criminal Court deserves the Sakharov Prize': CJEU President Koen Lenaerts
news.summary: We speak to the influential and long-serving president of the Court of Justice of the European Union (CJEU), Koen Lenaerts. The court is the EU's supreme judicial authority, responsible for ensuring that European law is interpreted and applied across all 27 member states.

news.title: What the rift within the Tsikhanouski family means for the Belarusian opposition in exile
news.summary: Siarhei Tsikhanouski criticizes the work of his wife, Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya, and her office. He also questions her legitimacy. What are the implications for Belarusian political forces in exile?

news.title: Stranded locals use rare truce to leave Moscow-occupied town in Ukraine
news.summary: Some residents of Oleshky, a Russian-occupied town in southern Ukraine ravaged by food and medicine shortages, left on Friday during a rare ceasefire brokered by the United States – due to end on Sunday evening. Ukrainian and Russian officials visited the town together on Friday, delivering aid and marshalling those who wanted to leave.

news.title: Casos de anorexia e bulimia crescem 71% em duas décadas
news.summary: Estudo que analisou dados de 204 países entre 1990 e 2023 mostra que os dois transtornos alimentares atingiam mais de 18 milhões de pessoas. Pesquisadores alertam para a continuidade dessa tendência até 2050.

news.title: Grupos espanhóis dominam último leilão de transmissão do ano
news.summary: Celeo, Cymi, Cox e Neoenergia arremataram lotes; EDP ficou com o ativo mais procurado, com linhas em Goiás e na Bahia

news.title: Star Wars: Has Russia's war with Ukraine gone intergalactic?
news.summary: Russian made an unprecedented combative move this month as one of its military satellites, the Cosmos-2612, encroached upon the orbit of Ukrainian commercial satellite, Iceye-X36, in behaviour deemed "threatening" by the US State Department. Norbert Pouzin, an orbital analyst at French space tech firm, Aldoria, described the mercenary manoeuvre as the first of its kind.

news.title: Democratas questionam papel de Trump em fuga de Flávio do Brasil
news.summary: Carta de 25 deputados dos EUA pede explicações sobre auxílio e vistos concedidos a senador e sua família após restrição do STF

news.title: Israel's election results are in. Here's what could happen next
news.summary: Israeli election results are in, showing the makeup of the country's next parliament but leaving open the question of who will be prime minister.

news.title: Police in Scotland launch Andrew and Epstein royal castle investigation
news.summary: Media reports say the inquiries are related to claims that women were trafficked to the king’s Balmoral estate.

news.title: Hundreds evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky during rare Ukraine ceasefire
news.summary: Hundreds of people are also understood to have stayed in the front-line town, despite the dangers.

news.title: Ceasefire allows evacuation from devastated Russian-occupied Oleshky
news.summary: But several hundred people are understood to have decided to stay in the frontline town, despite the lack of gas, electricity and running water.

news.title: Could US midterms impact the EU? Transatlantic ties hit new low after Trump-Putin diesel deal
news.summary: From the EU's perspective, the second Trump presidency has felt even more destabilising than the first. From making the false claim that the EU was set up to "screw" the United States, to slapping tariffs on European goods, to making territorial claims on Greenland, to doing a diesel deal with Vladimir Putin and telling Ukraine to get a new president, Donald Trump has more than ruffled feathers on this side of the ocean. He has shaken the very foundations of the historical transatlantic relationship.

news.title: Arsenal boss Arteta fires ‘Disneyland’ warning at Dowman after red card
news.summary: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta says he blasted Max Dowman for red card in shock cup loss at Fleetwood.

news.title: French port strikes: Unions 'will get better working conditions', but can they curb militarisation?
news.summary: Carys Garland is pleased to welcome Renaud Foucart, Senior Lecturer at the Department of Economics ECARES at Lancaster University. An international dockworkers’ strike brings into focus the relationship between organized labor, technological change and Europe’s expanding military investment. Foucart argues that port workers’ strategic position in global supply chains gives them exceptional leverage: “They know how powerful they are.” While questioning their ability to redirect military policy, he expects that leverage to secure concessions on automation and working conditions: “They can get those concessions. And I think they will get them.”

news.title: A historic vote born of fear and frustration for Palestinian citizens of Israel
news.summary: Large segments of Israel's Palestinian Arab minority have historically stayed home and not voted in the country's elections. But they turned out in record numbers this week, reflecting a desperation that outweighed any qualms about participation.

news.title: War in Ukraine: Evacuations under way in Russian-occupied Oleshky
news.summary: Starving and exhausted residents of Oleshky, a Russian-occupied town in southern Ukraine, were being evacuated on Friday, October 30, as part of a joint relief operation involving the opposing sides – the first operation of its kind in four years and eight months of war. FRANCE 24’s Ukraine correspondent Emmanuelle Chaze reports.

news.title: União Europeia propõe afrouxar regras para agrotóxicos e gera alerta
news.summary: Comissão Europeia avalia flexibilizar normas que controlam uso de agrotóxicos, acabando com o prazo de reavaliação de substâncias. Centenas de cientistas criticam a sugestão e pedem análise independente.

news.summary: Ministro Vieira de Mello Filho também citou restrições ao financiamento de empresas e repudiou demissões por escolhas políticas

news.title: French crowd gathers for anti-islamophobia rally in Paris suburb after attack
news.summary: In France, thousands were protesting in the Paris suburb of La Verrière on Friday, a week after a racist terrorist attack killed one person and injured five others. The suspect, identified as Kevin T., admitted he was targeting people based on their appearance or religion and has been transferred to a Paris court. FRANCE 24's Morgan Ayre reports.

news.summary: Israel has announced its final election results, tightened its siege on Hebron, and arrested people returning to Gaza.

news.title: Como será a evacuação de civis em Oleshky, cidade isolada na Ucrânia
news.summary: Trégua local entre Ucrânia e Rússia mediada por Melania Trump permite a chegada de ajuda humanitária e abre caminho para a retirada de civis de uma cidade devastada pela guerra e pelo isolamento.

news.title: US tech stocks see sharp falls over AI cost fears
news.summary: Shares in Intel continue to fall while the tech-heavy Nasdaq opens at its lowest level in more than two months.

news.title: Arranca la reunión de ministros de Exteriores del G20 en Atlanta sin foto de familia por la presencia de Lavrov
news.summary: La reunión de los ministros de Exteriores del G20 que se celebra este viernes y sábado en la ciudad estadounidense de Atlanta ha arrancado sin la tradicional foto de familia que normalmente acompaña a estos actos, ante la presencia del ministro de Exteriores ruso, Sergei Lavrov, que ha generado la repulsa de los socios europeos del club.

news.title: Swiss foreign minister talks political ties on rare visit to North Korea
news.summary: Switzerland formally reopens diplomatic office in North Korea after its closure in 2020.

news.title: Trump reverses course, reinstates cancelled campaign rallies
news.summary: The decision marks a sharp reversal after the US president said he didn't feel like he had to hold the events.

news.title: Biggest hack in history: Cryptocurrency giant Binance loses $6.3 billion
news.summary: Cryptocurrency exchange giant Binance has been targeted by a record-breaking $6.3 billion cyber heist, with blockchain intelligence firms linking the attack to North Korea. By Thursday night in the US, a coordinated effort by major crypto platforms successfully froze roughly $3 billion of the stolen assets during a high-stakes race to track and secure the digital funds.

news.title: Spain working to identify train crash dead as relatives' anguish grows
news.summary: A second day of mourning is underway in Spain, with some families still waiting for news about missing loved ones, following Wednesday's high speed train crash that killed 69 people. Some have flooded social media with desperate appeals for information, posting photos or describing the clothes their relatives were wearing when they boarded the trains.

news.title: Midterms 2026: The former neo-Nazi pastor speaking out against Trump
news.summary: According to one poll, 82 per cent of white evangelical Protestants voted for Donald Trump in the 2024 US presidential election. That makes pastor Caleb Campbell a significant outlier – he has been one of the few outspoken evangelical critics of the Trump administration, dating back to the president’s first term when he felt compelled to speak out against Trump’s plans to put “kids in cages” as part of an immigration crackdown. “I was told that I was possessed by a demon,” Campbell remembers. Now, as the midterms approach, he fears US politics and the current administration have become more distant than ever from the Bible’s teachings.

news.title: Israeli election: 'Netanyahu did not win, he lost dramatically,' former PM Barak says
news.summary: In an interview with FRANCE 24, former Israeli prime minister Ehud Barak said Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu "did not win" this week's election in Israel but "lost dramatically", and that his rival Gadi Eisenkot should ally with Arab parties. Barak also suggested that claims of Qatari funding for an Arab party aimed to distract from an ongoing corruption scandal, and warned that Netanyahu was ready to strike Iran to stay in power.

news.summary: MPT e OAB alertam para riscos jurídicos e democráticos
